name: interleukin 6 cytokine family signal transducer

function.text: IL6ST encodes interleukin-6 receptor subunit beta. Annotated molecular activities include coreceptor activity and cytokine activity. It participates in negative regulation of cytokine activity and autocrine signaling.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to hyper-IgE recurrent infection syndrome 4, autosomal recessive (autosomal recessive); hyper-IgE recurrent infection syndrome 4A, autosomal dominant (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Hepatocellular Carcinoma; Prostate. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
